description: Ministry of City Planning and Water Supply - Order made to acquisitions of immovable properties in Karaveddi West, Karaveddy D/S Division, Jaffna District for the constructions under Jaffna Kilinochchi Water Supply and Sanitation Project and in Kandakula, Pathahewaheta D/S Division, Kandy District for the constructions under Kundasale Haragama Water Supply Project
categorisation: This gazette content involves the acquisition of immovable property (land) for specific water supply projects under the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act. It contains detailed descriptions of land parcels, including their location, boundaries, extent (in perches), and claimants' information. The primary focus is on land acquisition for public infrastructure projects, which falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) dealing with land and property-related matters.
